I told Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message that the site for the new Marrow Agrisupply inbound lane is Gate 47.

That comes from #central-team, a channel Hollis is in. On Oct 14 Pree first posted Dock 23, then corrected it the same morning: she had read the wrong line, and the site is Gate 47. My reply mentions both so he doesn't use the old Dock 23 for the account sheet.
